name: dog_dash
description: Dog Dash - A 3D world exploration game.

scripts.prebuild: node tools/check_braces.cjs && npm run build:wasm && npm run copy:wasm
scripts.copy:wasm: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.mkdirSync('public/build', { recursive: true }); ['optimized.wasm','optimized.wasm.map'].forEach(f => { const src = 'build/' + f; const dest = 'public/build/' + f; if (fs.existsSync(src)) fs.copyFileSync(src, dest); });"
scripts.build:all-wasm: npm run build:wasm && npm run copy:wasm && bash scripts/build-cpp-wasm-if-available.sh
scripts.copy:cpp-wasm: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const src='build/game_cpp.wasm'; const dest='public/build/game_cpp.wasm'; if(fs.existsSync(src)){fs.mkdirSync('public/build',{recursive:true}); fs.copyFileSync(src,dest); console.log('Copied',dest);}"
scripts.predev: npm run build:wasm && npm run copy:wasm
